name: Mecatron KiCad Library
description: Footprints, symbols, and 3D models for Mecatron projects.
description_full: The Mecatron KiCad Library provides a unified set of schematic symbols, PCB footprints, and 3D models used across Mecatron projects. This collection is designed for high-quality mechanical and electronic design integration in KiCad. It includes verified component geometries, standardized naming, and consistent 3D alignment to support professional PCB workflows.
